@.about-hero-subtitle: Community-driven DSH plugin index · Minimal, Open, Community-driven
@!#what-is-dsh .section-paragraph:nth-of: DSH (DeepSeek Harness, dsh) is an open-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI, built on an "everything is a plugin" architecture driven by Cordis. It is in developer preview and iterating fast. With Node.js installed, run npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web to start the Web UI (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3080).

Plugins are the only way DSH gains new capabilities — vision, dashboards, environment bridges, workflow integrations and more all ship as plugins. DSH-Registry is a community-driven index of DSH plugins, automatically aggregating open-source DSH plugins from GitHub so developers can discover, browse and install them. There is no database and no backend: the data layer is a public Git repository — every index change is an auditable, revertable commit.
The crawler scans GitHub every 6 hours for repositories with the dsh-plugin topic; you can also open a PR against config/seeds.json to get indexed directly.
@#features .feature-card:nth-child(2) .f: A three-level trust badge (Unreviewed / Actively Maintained / Flagged) with fully public criteria — risk at a glance.
@#features .feature-card:nth-child(3) .f: The index lives entirely in a public Git repository; every change is a commit: diffable, revertable, community-auditable, and a clone away from disaster recovery.

@!#how-to-submit .section-paragraph:nth-: Want your DSH plugin indexed? Option 1 (recommended): open an issue — the "Submit" link in the nav leads straight to the submission form; just fill in the repository address. No fork required. Once the owner reviews and adds it to the seeds, the next crawl (≤6 hours) picks it up. Note: indexing is not auditing — indexing only adds the plugin to the index; its state remains "Unreviewed".
@#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(1: Click "Submit" in the nav to go straight to the issue form.
@!#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(: In the form owner/name; confirm dsh.bundle.patch is declared, README and LICENSE exist, then submit the issue.
@#how-to-submit .submit-step:nth-child(3: Once the owner merges it into the seeds, the server's next sync (≤6 hours) regenerates the index and the plugin goes live, marked "Unreviewed".
@!#how-to-submit .section-paragraph:nth-: Option 2 (passive): add the dsh-plugin topic to your GitHub repository and (recommended) declare dsh.registry metadata in package.json; the crawler discovers qualifying repositories on its 6-hour scan.

@#about .section-paragraph:nth-of-type(1: DSH-Registry is an aggregated search platform for the DSH ecosystem: it automatically scans portal/directory sites (dshfind, DSH Hub, etc.) and DSH plugin listings on GitHub, extracts metadata and builds an inverted index for fast search and discovery. This site is "search-first" — it stores metadata only (name, description, author, stars, etc.), never mirrors plugin code.
@#about .section-paragraph:nth-of-type(2: There are three listing sources: GitHub (repositories with the dsh-plugin topic or added to the submission seeds), dshfind (plugin scoring & discovery platform) and DSH Hub (community site). Data syncs automatically every 6 hours, and every plugin defaults to "Unreviewed".

@#about #transparency .transparency-item: Purpose
Discovery and aggregated search: a DSH plugin aggregated-search and open data source. Not curation, not source verification, not a distribution allowlist
Sources indexed
GitHub (dsh-plugin topic + seed submissions) · dshfind · DSH Hub (community site); synced every 6 hours
Crawling and site-friendliness
All crawls send a UA of DSHRegistryBot/1.0; per-domain rate limiting (≥1.5s/request); only robots-allowed paths and public data files are accessed, no page rendering is triggered
Review scope and exclusions
Metadata-level indexing and basic checks only (declares dsh.bundle.patch + has README/License). No code security review, no plugin behavior audit, no certification of any plugin
Ranking, sponsorship and conflicts of interest
Ranked by relevance / stars / recency only. No sponsored slots, no paid promotion, no commercial interests
Versions, artifacts, dependencies and update model
Data schemaVersion 1.1, published as open static JSON. Each update is one Git commit after a crawl run — auditable and reversible
Runtime risk signals
Three-state trust badges (Unreviewed is the default). No sandbox; installing executes all plugin code. Flagged is set manually
Maintainership transfer
Repository is public; contributions via Issues/PRs. If maintenance cannot continue, a notice and handover will be posted in the repository
Suspension, removal, notice and appeals
Repos that 404 or are deleted are removed automatically and recorded in changelog; blocklist is a manual removal. Appeals and reports go through GitHub Issues
Data, privacy and retention

Public metadata only. The site uses Baidu Analytics, which collects anonymized visit data (e.g. page views) solely for site maintenance and optimization reference; theme/language preference stays in your browser. Data lives in a public Git repo and retains history across crawls
Shutdown and export
All data is public JSON and exportable anytime. In case of shutdown, code and data stay on GitHub; the site domain may go offline
Last reviewed
